purpose: The four-row form proof of Stage-3 S3-6 CELL-1 (owner decisions 83, 99, 101, 106), re-registered under a new run id. THIRD FAILURE, v2 SMOKE RUN ID RETIRED (2026-09-23). Run id SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-DELTA-CELL-SMOKE-4-V2 spent 12 contacts on the four rows and died at the openJiuwen vertex reviewer_0_input with 'acquire must introduce at least one new value or facet'. Rows 1 and 3 completed their episodes; rows 2 and 4 did not, because the Reviewer slice of the released stage3-deltas store addresses 30 of the 39 legal intents and neither row's Perception candidates fall in it, so the per-node candidate-bound route selected NOTHING and still returned a supply -- and any supply makes rails.controllers.advance_phase_response_state emit an acquire transition, which AgentStepTransition.validate then refuses. The Solver never showed it because that phase composes three supplies and a sibling always carried a value; the Reviewer and the Planner are served by this store alone. The unit ladder had PINNED the defect (a test asserting 'an empty but valid supply'), and the offline dry run missed it twice because its canned Perception answer was built from the store's union of addressed facets, it walked only the roster's first row -- one of the two that completed -- and it never walked a REVISE revisit. The fix is rails.knowledge_stores._stage3_delta_local_supply: a route that introduces nothing new supplies NOTHING (no acquire transition at all), the already-acquired ids are dropped before the per-node cap is applied, and each skip is receipted as delta_supply {node, selected, already_acquired, reason}. It is proven offline, before this flight, by analysis.native_episode_dry_run walking this exact composition node by node on all four rows with the candidate ids the v2 attempt's own trace recorded, plus the REVISE revisit path, at zero contacts (tests/unit/test_native_episode_dry_run.py, tests/unit/test_stage3_delta_supply_router.py). Same fragments, same store pins, same population, same split identity, same geometry, same session and the same caps as the retired v2 smoke; only the run, attempt and fit identities move, because a plan budget is run-cumulative across every attempt of one run id. STRUCTURAL ONLY: no official score is run here and no effectiveness claim is read from it. The twin smoke keeps its own v1 run id (SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-DELTA-CELL-SMOKE-4-TWIN-V1, never opened) and stays registered in configs/experiment/slurp-native-stage3-delta-cell-smoke-4-v1.json; it carries the same fix through the shared rails module.
